posts.author: AWS ML
posts.text: Introducing Reflection Beam: an open-weight model for agentic coding on AWS. Reflection AI's Beam is an open-weight model for agentic coding and long-horizon tasks. This post shows how to deploy Beam on AWS: start with an Amazon SageMaker JumpStart real-time endpoint, or use Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Inference with JumpStart, SGLang, or vLLM for Kubernetes-native control over distributed GPU infrastructure.

posts.author: The Decoder
posts.text: Google's Gemini 4 Argon is closer to the AI frontier than any Google model in months. Google Deepmind's Gemini 4 Argon scored 97.5 percent on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark, making Google the second lab after OpenAI to cross the 95 percent mark. But the results swing wildly depending on the test setup: in the standard harness, the score drops to just 49.8 percent. Argon also trails rivals in math and software engineering. DAILY AI BRIEF 🗞 — Oct 17

OPENAI 🔥:
- OpenAI upgraded GPT-6 Astra Pro in ChatGPT with faster responses, better plugin and tool use, and multiple agents working in parallel, now available to Pro users.
- Codex and Work now give more effective usage by reusing context across subagents, caching it longer, and routing requests for more cache hits.

GOOGLE 🔥:
- Google AI Pro subscribers can now build with Gemini 4 Argon in AI Studio Build and the playground.
- Google AI Studio Build added Plan and Max modes for planning before changes and working longer for better results.
